$comment: Hero backdrop particle generator inputs. DEVELOPER CONFIG, not editable copy — do NOT hand this to the CMS. src/data/hero.js expands these into HERO_PARTICLES with a deterministic formula (no Math.random) so the server and client render identical markup and hydration never mismatches. Each generated value is consumed by the `.hero-particle` rule in hero.css as a CSS custom property.

formula.$comment: left = leftBase + (i * leftStep) % leftRange, and so on. Kept as data so the spread can be retuned without touching code.
